query_plan.query: Which province is the northernmost province in China?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by province, order by latitude descending, and return the top result as the northernmost province.
steps.query: Return all provinces in China together with their latitude.

extra.sql_query: SELECT provinces.name FROM provinces ORDER BY CAST( SUBSTR( provinces.coords, INSTR(provinces.coords, ' ') + 1, INSTR(provinces.coords, ')') - INSTR(provinces.coords, ' ') - 1 ) AS REAL ) DESC LIMIT 1

s1.sql_query: SELECT provinces.name AS name, CAST( SUBSTR(provinces.coords, INSTR(provinces.coords, ' ') + 1, INSTR(provinces.coords, ')') - INSTR(provinces.coords, ' ') - 1 ) AS REAL ) AS latitude FROM provinces
